entities.summary: Valery Loginov, is a Soviet and Russian chess Grandmaster (GM) (1991) who from 1992 to 1995 played for Uzbekistan. Three-times Uzbekistani Chess Championship winner, Saint Petersburg City Chess Championship, Chess Olympiad team silver medalist (1992).
